name: print-social-car-sharing-launch-invitation-dark-green-scribble-loops
title: 'Launch event of our new APP' car-sharing invitation with mint scribble loops and a floating route-list card
whatItIs: A dark green portrait invitation with mint green scribbled loop lines in the corners, 'INVITATION — Car Sharing' header, 'Share A Car' tagline, a bold headline 'Launch event of our new APP' with 'new' in script, a date/time line, and a floating phone-screen card showing a route search list with avatars and green add buttons.
whatItMeans: Playful yet informative; the loose scribble loops soften a launch-event invite while the floating app card previews the product itself.
techniques: Frame a dark invitation with loose hand-drawn scribble loops.
Preview the actual product UI as a floating card.
Highlight one word of the headline in a casual script.

vocabulary.definition: A loose, hand-drawn looping line used as decoration.
A screen preview shown as if hovering above the layout.
